intro.text: One of the Fused, who takes the body of the listener Demid.

items.text: Hariel was one of the first Fused to come back through the Everstorm, taking the body of the listener Demid, Venli's former mate. When Venli asked for Demid back, Ulim hurried to warn her to show more respect; Hariel explained that the Fused don't share bodies, and that Demid's soul was gone for good.

He told Venli that her body had been meant for another Fused before Odium gave her envoyform instead, and that she would be taken to Alethkar. He did not notice the small spren she had seen and hidden.

appearance.text: Large and statuesque, with a broad chest, carapace along his arms and face, and red eyes. He towers over Venli and speaks the Fused's ancient language in a deep, commanding voice.

personality.text: He expects lower-ranked singers to obey him, and seems clearer of mind than many Fused. Ulim thinks him one of the worst-tempered; Hariel respects Ulim's work but dislikes his human-like ways.
